head_coach.name: Marcelo Bielsa
head_coach.play_style_summary: High-intensity vertical play, relentless pressing, rapid transitions, and heavy emphasis on vertical wing movements and high stamina.

key_players.name: Federico Valverde
key_players.performance_stats: Captains both the national team and Real Madrid; widely regarded as one of the most versatile midfielders globally with exceptional stamina, work rate, and vertical driving runs.

key_players.name: Maximiliano Araújo
key_players.performance_stats: A key attacking outlet under Bielsa, providing essential pace, directness, and crossing ability from the left flank.

key_players.name: Manuel Ugarte
key_players.performance_stats: Plays for Manchester United; acts as the crucial defensive anchor and primary axis for building out possession from the back.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Sidelined due to a severe cruciate ligament tear with recovery expected to last until late October 2026.
Suffered a Grade 2 calf muscle tear shortly before the World Cup; although kept in the tournament squad, he is ruled out of the entire group stage.
Unavailable due to an adductor tear.
Omitted from the final World Cup squad by head coach Marcelo Bielsa despite declaring his willingness to contribute.
